## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make release` passes
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese resources remain in sync
- [ ] Public behavior changes are documented in both READMEs

## Display Safety

- [ ] This change does not modify display-mode behavior
- [ ] Or, I tested the display-mode change on the hardware described below and verified restoration
- [ ] No virtual display, override, EDID modification, capture stream, privileged helper, or administrator requirement was introduced

For display-mode changes, include the macOS version, Mac model, display model, connection path, original mode, target mode, and final restored mode.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for interface changes when applicable.
